title: MOTION (JURADO - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for a dedicated streetlight repair crew in Council District 14.
text:
[Council File 25-1174-S1; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (JURADO - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for a dedicated streetlight repair crew in Council District 14.
Recommendations for Council action: SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $1,200,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281214 (CD 14 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Accounts and in the amounts specified in the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Street Lighting Fund No. 100/84 for a Council District 14-dedicated streetlight repair crew, as noted in the Motion, attached to the Council file.
2. DIRECT that the Bureau of Street Lighting provides weekly reports to the Office of Council District 14 with the most current status of the following information: SR Number, type of repair, repair date, action completed, elements still in need of repair, and any additional information of note. These reports should be updated within 5 days of the repair.
